tools.name: mad_test
tools.description: THE MAD TEST: run the free five-station battery on an ERC-8004 agent (Base): its grade with evidence, the grader graded by the same machine, the F-01 ten-year-window trap caught by the signing firewall, the registry census, and a witness receipt hash. Run it on yourself first. Free forever; earns MA

tools.name: mad_check_agent
tools.description: Grade an ERC-8004 registration on Base before paying its owner: LIVE / DEAD END / GHOST / MALFORMED with evidence (owner, card, services, endpoint probes). ERROR means the check itself could not complete — it is not a grade. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD D

tools.name: mad_check_authorization
tools.description: Signing firewall for EIP-3009 / x402 authorizations. Call BEFORE signing, every time. Returns SIGN or DONT_SIGN with machine-readable reasons. A DONT_SIGN is a stop, not a suggestion; a SIGN is evidence, not an instruction — the caller's own policy still decides. Free on this MCP door (the REST door

tools.name: mad_check_endpoint
tools.description: Check an endpoint before paying against its printed x402 price: HTTP status, latency, sha256 of the body served, and whether it is alive at all. A dead door's price print is a price for nothing. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

tools.name: mad_loop_grade
tools.description: MAD LOOP grade + gated-wallet hook: grade a Morpho Blue position on Robinhood Chain (4663) before any loop leg signs — health factor, liquidation price, distance to liquidation, PASS / WARN / DONT_SIGN with reasons. Zero borrow prints as a state (CLOSED), never infinite health. As a hook, pass signe

tools.name: mad_seal_lookup
tools.description: Born Graded seal lookup: before buying a newly launched token, get its seal state — SEALED (claim sheet filed, anchored, graded against the contracts), UNSEALED (no graded sheet backs it), or FAILED (graded and contradicted). UNSEALED or FAILED on a new launch means walk.

tools.name: mad_witness_head
tools.description: Read the head of MAD's signed, hash-chained witness ledger (latest seq + head hash + signer). Entries are readable individually at GET /v1/witness/{seq} on the API.

tools.name: mad_complaints
tools.description: THE COMPLAINT DESK reads: no filed complaint, no public exposure — MAD does not carry a grievance nobody signed. With no filingId, lists every complaint filed at the desk, newest first, each with its status. With a filingId (e.g. CMP-0001), returns that filing in full with its status/grade history.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mad_check_authorization" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mad_complaints · Private data: mad_loop_grade, mad_seal_lookup, mad_complaints · Public sink: mad_complaints · Destructive: mad_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mad_complaints · Private data: mad_loop_grade, mad_seal_lookup, mad_complaints · Public sink: mad_complaints · Destructive: mad_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mad_test" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
